dct_description_sm: Abstract: Key landmarks within King County, Washington categorized into several major classes including but not limited to Government Sites; Major Commercial Sites; Transportation Facilities; Schools & Colleges; Sports & Leisure Facilities; Medical Facilities; Transit Center; Park and Ride Lots & Metro Tunnel Station; etc.

Purpose: The landmark database was generated for the ATIS application used by the Regional Automated Trip Planning group (RATP). This group assists Metro bus riders to get from one location to another taking the best route possible. Landmarks are often used to determine the origin and destination of trips instead of addresses.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
